name: Barcode Scanner
description:
A text field with a Scan button that reads QR codes and barcodes with the device camera.

Formats: QR Code, EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A, UPC-E, Code 128, Code 39, Code 93, Codabar, ITF, Data Matrix, PDF417 and Aztec, read with ZXing in WebAssembly, so it works in every current browser, not only those with a built-in barcode reader. Scanner: live camera view with a viewfinder, the code outlined when found, beep and vibration, flashlight, switch camera, and Scan an Image for photos or devices without a camera. Close after one code, or Keep Scanning for stock counts. Field: users can still type or paste the code, and all usual item settings apply (Value Required, placeholder, read only). The camera needs HTTPS (or localhost) and the user's permission.

Live demo: sign in as demo with the password Demo.

Requires Oracle APEX 26.2 or later. Documentation, updates and more plug-ins: https://www.techrevx.com
